svg.title: AI Season quest map — 12 levels in 6 worlds
svg.desc: Course path: 1 Agent Foundations, 2 Prompt Engineering and Vibe Coding, 3 RAG and Vector Databases, 4 Design Patterns, 5 LangChain and LangGraph, 6 Mid Test boss, 7 Deployment, 8 Security and Guardrails, 9 MCP and Agent SDK, 10 Voice Agent, 11 Excalidraw Capstone, 12 Final Test boss. Reward: full refund for the top 3 and a verifiable certificate.
svg.text: 6 weeks · 2 live sessions a week · Cohort 02: 1 Jan → 12 Feb 2027
